# BMS v0.0.3

Firmware **0.0.3+VC73** (`bfb4db4`, `version_code` 73). Tag `v0.0.3` on `master-grok`, published 24 Nov 2026 (Europe/Vilnius); the earlier v0.0.3 was 0.0.3+VC63 (`d046dd1`). Verified on the live .158 pack.

## VC65–VC73

- VC65: BLE coredump_info and coredump_get
- VC66: BLE passkey pairing, bonding, and PIN reset
- VC67: show Read OTA data in a modal
- VC68: make grace and timeout timers safe across millis() rollover
- VC69: Resubscribe all MQTT topics after every connect
- VC70: Hold a BLE contactor close through every failsafe
- VC71: Honor the manual contactor hold on PSA 82 type 3
- VC72: Restyle the OTA page to match the dash
- VC73: Add an OTA button on the Status page

## Also in this release (after v0.0.2, through VC63)

- Drop the web Settings and Battery tabs; settings are BLE-only (`cfg_get` / `cfg_set` / `cfg_schema`)
- Publish cell and temperature CSV over MQTT (`cell_data`, `temp_data`); `rt` stays compact and adds module geometry
- Move the standalone CAN dash to OPF-DASH
- Give every web control a BLE command and drop the USB serial console
- Expose the cached pack DTC list on the BLE console (`dtc_list` / `DTC|` notify)
- VC53: remove Status action sections and their HTTP endpoints
- VC54: remove Status Health and flatten Device Overview
- VC55: remove BMS self-test and keep the OTA boot-health gate
- VC56: remove Dashboard Site summary and keep its values on Status
- VC57: add ap_hidden so the SoftAP can hide its SSID; drop the Hide SSID control from the Status page
- VC58: remove the Live data row from the Dashboard
- VC59: match application HTTP routes exactly
- VC60: build /diag snapshot off async_tcp; fix slim /health snapshot
- VC61: remove /health full duplicate and dead code
- VC62: task watchdog config + heartbeat snapshot in reboot log; fix task heartbeat ages
- VC63: coalesce soak NVS writes; label async_tcp heartbeat (not_watched, last feed on async_tcp_last_feed_age_ms)

BRIDGE.runtime_config: PlatformIO builds ESP32_S3 (published as ATOM_S3_R.bin and ATOM_S3.bin; runtime NVS hw_board selects Atom S3 / Atom S3R / Waveshare OPF_WS) and ESP32 (ESP32.bin = LilyGO T-CAN485 only). DTU vs RS485 is a device setting. v0.0.2 hardware soak proven on Atom S3R (.110) only; WS and T-CAN485 are built for feed but not hardware-proven.
BRIDGE.release_notes:
# BRIDGE v0.0.3

Firmware **0.0.3+VC47** (`12551a4`, `version_code` 47). Tag `v0.0.3` on `master-grok`, retagged 24 Nov 2026 (Europe/Vilnius); the earlier v0.0.3 was 0.0.3+VC43 (`ad9dc39`).

v0.0.3 moves all device settings to BLE (`cfg_schema` / `cfg_get` / `cfg_set`), leaves the web UI as a dashboard plus a read-only Status page, removes inverter auto-detect, hardens the firmware for 24/7 operation, adds BLE PIN pairing and a crash summary, and lists Sungrow SH6.0RS.

## Changes since v0.0.2 (0.0.2+VC34)

- **VC35:** web settings editors removed. Inverter and LoRa tabs are gone and Status-page actions (RS-485 tests, restarts, factory reset, SoftAP open/close, telemetry resume, smartmeter capture) move to BLE (`reboot`, `mqtt_restart`, `factory_reset`, `ap_open` / `ap_close`, `sta_drop`, `rs485_*`, `sm_cap`, `p1_key_set` / `p1_key_clear`, `p1_reboot`, `p1_uart_restart`). Every former web setting keeps its BLE key.
- **VC36:** Wi-Fi, SoftAP and MQTT (including TLS, the CA and the MQTT OTA host list) are BLE-only. The Settings tab, `POST /device`, `POST /api/security` and `GET /wifi/scan` are removed; `GET /device` stays for the Dashboard. The USB serial command console is removed (logs, `[BOOT]` line and panic text remain; esptool flashing is unchanged).
- **VC37:** Status drops the RS-485, Inverter Detect and Soft AP sections. Those were already BLE-only; the removed HTTP paths return `{"ok":false,"error":"not_found"}`.
- **VC38:** the hidden Profile selector and Status Warnings / Recent events are removed. Profile is BLE `cfg_set` only. `/diag`, `/health` and `/values` keep every key.
- **VC39:** inverter auto-detect removed. Boot loads the saved profile and does not probe the bus; `detect_*` BLE commands are unknown. Manual profile and slave selection, `rs485_info` and `rs485_scan` stay. Inverter writes are never auto-enabled; the write gate is set only by BLE `cfg_set` or MQTT `inv_writes`.
- **VC40:** Status is one plain read-only list.
- **VC41:** `ap_hidden` SoftAP setting (NVS, default 0), reported on `/diag` and `/health`, cleared by factory reset.
- **VC42:** unused dashboard WebSocket and dead web JS removed. MQTT TX buffer raised to 12288 so the ~8.3 KB heartbeat and diag publish. Health and diag buffers are reused, BLE notifies are paced, and `lora_rx` is on the task watchdog.
- **VC43:** the Storage and Battery confirm popup is replaced by an apply review page. Back (button, Esc, browser back) returns to the previous tab and keeps edits; Apply posts the same `/api/profile-command` batch.
- **VC44:** `/diag` reports `cdump_present` and, when a panic image is stored, a compact `cdump` summary (reason, cause, task, pc, backtrace, fw, ELF sha; max 288 B). Size map in `docs/SIZE_VC44.md`, LVGL trimmed, unused features compiled out on ESP32.
- **VC45:** BLE SMP passkey pairing with bonding (MITM, display-only, static passkey); TX/RX need an encrypted, authenticated link. New BLE keys `ble_auth` (default 1) and `ble_pin` (4-6 digits), `ble_pin_reset` over BLE (`confirm=1`) and USB, `auth:` command; `/diag` adds `ble_pin_set`, `ble_auth`, `ble_bonds`, `ble_encrypted`. Factory reset restores the default PIN and clears bonds. See `docs/BLE_PAIRING.md`.
- **VC46:** default BLE PIN is **123456**. A stored 1234 is removed once at boot and bonds are cleared.
- **VC47:** Sungrow SH6.0RS (profile `20`) is listed on the BLE `profile` schema (`0,1,10,11,20`, locked by a host test) and in the manuals; on profile 20 the Dashboard shows import / export / idle (max 5000 W), max export and max charge / discharge current. Review notes in `docs/SUNGROW_SH6RS.md`. No web profile picker (model selection stays in the Flasher and BLE app).

Remaining write-capable web endpoints: `POST /api/profile-command` (Dashboard controls), `POST /api/ota-preflight`, `POST /api/ota-url` and ElegantOTA `/update`. Deye register 80 remains read-only. AUTOMATIC_MODE is unchanged.

## Hardware validation

- Atom S3R `.110` runs VC47 (`12551a4`, boot 577, 35 h+ uptime with no unexpected reboot, MQTT 3/3 SUBACK-confirmed, P1 OK, `inv_writes`=1, Deye HV). VC44/VC46/VC47 soak since 20 Nov: free heap 88-97 KB, no new panic. Waveshare (ATOM_S3) and T-CAN485 (ESP32) images are built for the feed; T-CAN485 site flash is held until on-site rollback is possible.
- Sungrow SH6.0RS is code-reviewed and host-tested only; no Sungrow unit has been tested.
- T-CAN485 has no BLE and no serial commands, so its Wi-Fi/MQTT keys stay at the NVS values or the one-time build-flag seed.

## Build

Built locally from a clean `12551a4` worktree with Arduino-ESP32 3.20016 (espressif32@6.7.0), without `platformio.local.ini` secrets, and published to the FEED with `scripts/publish_firmware_feed.py`.

P1.release_notes:
# P1 v0.0.2

**Frequency is 869.525 MHz (EU868 g3).** This is fw16: firmware **0.0.2+VC16** (`1196aee`, `version_code` 16; the device's own version text reads `0.0.2+16`). Tag `v0.0.2` on `master-grok`. Flash both images from this release together. The radio settings and uplink format are the same as v0.0.1.

- Fast uplink (type `0x06`, 39 bytes) every 1 s. Slow uplink (type `0x07`, 21 bytes) every 30 s. Protocol version byte stays 4. SF7, BW125, CR4/5, preamble 8, sync `0x1424`, 22 dBm. Rolling 1-hour transmit cap stays under 10% duty.
- `P1_REQUIRE_CRC=0`. A telegram with a missing or wrong CRC is accepted only if it carries U1-3, I1-3 and import power and passes the plausibility guard. A CRC-matching telegram is accepted without that guard.
- Plausibility guard: voltages are 0 V or 150-280 V, with at least one phase in 150-280 V; currents are at most 100 A; every present power is at most `P1_MAX_POWER_W` (50 kW); frequency, when sent, is 45-55 Hz.
- A new `/` at the start of a line restarts the telegram, so a telegram cut short on the wire is dropped instead of being glued to the next one.
- A missing frequency line goes out as 0 Hz, not 50 Hz.
- After 10 s without an accepted telegram the transmitter restarts USART1 (RCC reset, clear ORE/FE/NE/PE, flush, parser reset), whether or not bytes are still arriving. LoRa keeps sending the last known-good values marked invalid.
- Transmitter stall watchdog only fires while a transmit is actually in progress. Duty-cycle refusal and idle time no longer count as a radio fault. Watchdog beat age is signed, so a beat newer than the sample time counts as fresh.
- A P1 hard reset calls `NVIC_SystemReset` immediately, including with a debugger attached. The reset marker is stored with its complement.
- Radio recovery is split into soft and hard. A hard radio reinit happens only after 3 consecutive faults, and a TX timeout is no longer counted twice.
- The P1 UART is fully drained after a reinit (up to 512 bytes).
- LoRa commands: type `0x08` (24-byte command) and type `0x09` (22-byte result), protocol version 1, AES-CMAC. Opcodes are REBOOT `0x01`, P1_UART `0x02`, and RADIO `0x03`. Commands are accepted only when the transmitter is built with a command key. This FEED transmitter image is unkeyed, so commands are disabled.
- Receiver: Modbus answers exception `0x0B` once no valid frame has arrived for 3 s, so an unplugged meter no longer freezes the last watts. Link stale and Modbus hold are both 3 s.
- Receiver: Modbus reads outside the register map answer exception `0x02`.
- Field diagnostics over SWD (`gFieldDiag`, plus `gFwVersionText` for the `0.0.2+16` display string) include radio IRQ, header error, RSSI/SNR, recovery-pending, last sequence, soft-fault and hard-recovery counters, last valid telegram age, watchdog beat-ahead/stale and reset-marker status, and P1 reject diagnostics (bytes seen, telegrams seen and rejected, last reject reason and OBIS prefix, per-reason counts, sticky UART error bits).
- New PlatformIO env `direct` (P1 to Modbus RS485 with no LoRa) for a meter wired straight to the inverter. It is not part of this feed release.

# BMS v0.0.2

Firmware **0.0.2+VC48** (`version_code` 48). Tag `v0.0.2` points at `970de34`, where VERSION is `0.0.2+48`. The FEED binaries were built from `e4fd3b3` (the v0.0.2 feed publish). `+48` maps to `VC48` because VCnn continues the same counter (VC53 came right after 0.0.3+52).

- Web UI: v0.0.1 layout restored (Dashboard, Battery, Settings, Status). New settings sit as plain fields in their v0.0.1 sections.
- Soft start: after boot, charge and discharge limits ramp from 5 A to max over 60 s.
- SoC taper: charge and discharge limits ramp from 5 A at the low and high SoC ends and near cell voltage limits.
- Low-SoC fix: SoC follows IVT Ah counting (charge raises it), seeded from the real reading once cells are valid, with spike rejection and hysteresis. Stops the 5%/7% charge/discharge loop.
- Soft stop: OTA and other requested reboots ramp current down first, then reboot.
- Crash fix: `logs_loop` panic (JSON allocator double-free, unlocked console print, MQTT publish race).
- Settings: keys over 15 characters renamed so they save.
- `/health`: ramp, taper, SoC and last restart reason fields.
- Stability from earlier on this line: OTA watchdog fix, coredump capture and `/coredump`, PSA2 96-cell decode, IVT support, UV failsafe.

# P1 v0.0.2

**Frequency is 869.525 MHz (EU868 g3).** This is fw16: firmware **0.0.2+VC16** (`1196aee`, `version_code` 16; the device's own version text reads `0.0.2+16`). Tag `v0.0.2` on `master-grok`. Flash both images from this release together. The radio settings and uplink format are the same as v0.0.1.

- Fast uplink (type `0x06`, 39 bytes) every 1 s. Slow uplink (type `0x07`, 21 bytes) every 30 s. Protocol version byte stays 4. SF7, BW125, CR4/5, preamble 8, sync `0x1424`, 22 dBm. Rolling 1-hour transmit cap stays under 10% duty.
- `P1_REQUIRE_CRC=0`. A telegram with a missing or wrong CRC is accepted only if it carries U1-3, I1-3 and import power and passes the plausibility guard. A CRC-matching telegram is accepted without that guard.
- Plausibility guard: voltages are 0 V or 150-280 V, with at least one phase in 150-280 V; currents are at most 100 A; every present power is at most `P1_MAX_POWER_W` (50 kW); frequency, when sent, is 45-55 Hz.
- A new `/` at the start of a line restarts the telegram, so a telegram cut short on the wire is dropped instead of being glued to the next one.
- A missing frequency line goes out as 0 Hz, not 50 Hz.
- After 10 s without an accepted telegram the transmitter restarts USART1 (RCC reset, clear ORE/FE/NE/PE, flush, parser reset), whether or not bytes are still arriving. LoRa keeps sending the last known-good values marked invalid.
- Transmitter stall watchdog only fires while a transmit is actually in progress. Duty-cycle refusal and idle time no longer count as a radio fault. Watchdog beat age is signed, so a beat newer than the sample time counts as fresh.
- A P1 hard reset calls `NVIC_SystemReset` immediately, including with a debugger attached. The reset marker is stored with its complement.
- Radio recovery is split into soft and hard. A hard radio reinit happens only after 3 consecutive faults, and a TX timeout is no longer counted twice.
- The P1 UART is fully drained after a reinit (up to 512 bytes).
- LoRa commands: type `0x08` (24-byte command) and type `0x09` (22-byte result), protocol version 1, AES-CMAC. Opcodes are REBOOT `0x01`, P1_UART `0x02`, and RADIO `0x03`. Commands are accepted only when the transmitter is built with a command key. This FEED transmitter image is unkeyed, so commands are disabled.
- Receiver: Modbus answers exception `0x0B` once no valid frame has arrived for 3 s, so an unplugged meter no longer freezes the last watts. Link stale and Modbus hold are both 3 s.
- Receiver: Modbus reads outside the register map answer exception `0x02`.
- Field diagnostics over SWD (`gFieldDiag`, plus `gFwVersionText` for the `0.0.2+16` display string) include radio IRQ, header error, RSSI/SNR, recovery-pending, last sequence, soft-fault and hard-recovery counters, last valid telegram age, watchdog beat-ahead/stale and reset-marker status, and P1 reject diagnostics (bytes seen, telegrams seen and rejected, last reject reason and OBIS prefix, per-reason counts, sticky UART error bits).
- New PlatformIO env `direct` (P1 to Modbus RS485 with no LoRa) for a meter wired straight to the inverter. It is not part of this feed release.
